us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: House votes again to curb Trump’s Iran war powers
bullets: The U.S. House approved a war-powers resolution for a third time.
The measure seeks to halt continued military action in Iran without congressional approval.
The vote comes as the Iran conflict continues to weigh on politics and energy prices.

articles.title: Supreme Court rejects Trump mail-ballot restrictions ahead of midterms
bullets: The Supreme Court rejected the administration’s bid to restrict mail ballots for now.
Voting is already underway in some places for the 2026 midterms.
Trump criticized the ruling and the justices who opposed his position.

articles.title: NBC and Telemundo news helicopter crash kills three in Los Angeles
bullets: A news helicopter crashed in the Chatsworth area while covering a bus collision.
NBC4 and Telemundo 52 said the helicopter was providing aerial news coverage.
Officials reported at least three deaths in the helicopter crash.

articles.title: U.S. charges five in alleged Russian-backed murder plots
bullets: The Justice Department unsealed charges tied to alleged Russian intelligence-linked plots.
Authorities said the network targeted people in the U.S. and abroad.
The FBI said it disrupted a plot involving a Russian dissident believed to be in Washington.
articles.source: Associated Press / U.S. Department of Justice

articles.title: Pennsylvania reports fourth measles-associated death
bullets: Pennsylvania officials reported another measles-associated death.
AP identified it as the fourth such death reported in the state.
The case adds to public-health concerns around measles outbreaks and vaccination gaps.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories and geopolitical developments

articles.title: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted Houthi drone near Mecca
bullets: Saudi Arabia accused Yemen’s Houthis of attempting an attack near Mecca.
The Saudi-led coalition said air defenses destroyed the drone before it entered prohibited airspace.
Houthi officials denied targeting Islamic holy sites.

articles.title: Russian drone strike kills five on passenger bus in Ukraine
bullets: A Russian drone hit a passenger bus in southeastern Ukraine.
Officials reported five deaths and at least seven injuries.
The attack occurred near active front-line areas.

articles.title: Rodrigo Duterte appears at ICC hearing in The Hague
bullets: Former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte appeared in an International Criminal Court hearing.
He faces charges of crimes against humanity tied to his anti-drug campaign.
It was his first public appearance in more than a year, according to AP.

articles.title: Indonesia finance minister ousted after reported internal clash
bullets: Reuters reported President Prabowo Subianto dismissed Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa.
Sources said the move followed a clash with a senior ministry official linked to Prabowo’s former military circle.
The shake-up drew attention to Indonesia’s fiscal credibility and policy direction.

articles.title: Seoul court orders North Korea to pay $32.5 million over liaison office blast
bullets: A South Korean court ordered North Korea to pay 44.6 billion won in damages.
The case concerns North Korea’s 2020 demolition of the inter-Korean liaison office in Kaesong.
AP said it marked a symbolic legal win for Seoul.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India-focused political, legal and economic stories

articles.title: India summons Pakistan diplomat after naval collision at sea
bullets: India lodged a protest over a collision involving Pakistani naval units and an Indian Navy vessel.
The incident occurred in international waters and caused no major damage, officials said.
New Delhi called the Pakistani conduct unacceptable and unprofessional.

articles.title: ED flags insolvency frauds and large bankruptcy ‘haircuts’ as priority areas
bullets: India’s Enforcement Directorate identified IBC-related frauds as a key enforcement focus.
The agency cited collusive resolutions, inflated related-party claims and asset stripping as concerns.
The review followed the ED’s quarterly conference of zonal officers in Bengaluru.

articles.title: UPI merchant-fee framework draws fresh clarifications and industry reaction
bullets: NPCI issued FAQs on the MDR framework for select UPI person-to-merchant transactions.
Fuel payments below ₹2,000 remain at zero MDR, according to CNBC-TV18’s summary.
Payment-company founders welcomed the move while debate continued over consumer impact.

articles.title: India trade deficit narrows as exports rise 26% in August
bullets: Hindustan Times listed the trade-deficit story among its latest India updates.
The report said India’s exports rose 26% in August.
The narrower deficit comes as oil prices and currency pressure remain in focus.

articles.title: Sanjukta Parashar becomes first woman to head CRPF’s CoBRA unit
bullets: IPS officer Sanjukta Parashar was named chief of the CRPF’s CoBRA unit.
NDTV reported she is the first woman to lead the commando force.
She previously served in the National Investigation Agency.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Notable U.S. market movers and stock-specific catalysts

articles.title: Skyworks surges on Apple supplier hopes and Qorvo deal progress
bullets: Skyworks shares rose sharply, with market data showing a gain of about 13.6%.
Reports cited optimism tied to Apple’s new device lineup and RF component demand.
Investors also reacted to progress on the pending Qorvo merger.

articles.title: Qorvo jumps as Skyworks merger confidence improves
bullets: Qorvo shares rose about 9.3% in the latest market data.
Reports tied the move to comments that the Skyworks-Qorvo merger is in final regulatory stages.
The deal is expected to create a larger radio-frequency chip supplier.
articles.source: Ad Hoc News / TipRanks / Seeking Alpha

articles.title: Wingstop tumbles as restaurant stocks sell off
bullets: Wingstop shares fell about 12% in the latest trading data.
Dow Jones reported restaurant stocks slid after traffic data showed weaker visits.
Cava, Shake Shack and Brinker also fell in the same consumer-stock selloff.

articles.title: Enova drops after pulling Grasshopper Bancorp acquisition applications
bullets: Enova shares fell more than 23% in the latest market data.
Investing.com reported the company withdrew regulatory applications tied to buying Grasshopper Bancorp.
Enova reaffirmed full-year guidance despite ending the banking-expansion deal path.

articles.title: Alignment Healthcare sinks to 52-week low
bullets: Alignment Healthcare shares fell about 19.6% in the latest market data.
Yahoo Finance reported the stock traded down with other healthcare names.
The company is down sharply year to date and well below its 52-week high.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate deals, regulation and company news

articles.title: OpenAI explores funding talks that could value it near $1.2 trillion
bullets: Reuters cited an FT report that OpenAI held early talks with large investors.
The discussions could value the ChatGPT maker at about $1.2 trillion before an IPO.
OpenAI declined to comment on the report.

articles.title: Grab to buy majority stake in Atome Financial for $1.49 billion
bullets: Grab agreed to acquire a 60% controlling stake in Atome Financial.
The company said the deal will expand its consumer-lending and BNPL business across Southeast Asia.
Grab expects its financial-services segment to reach $500 million in adjusted EBITDA by 2028.

articles.title: Brookfield agrees to $2.9 billion buyout of Australia’s Reliance Worldwide
bullets: Reliance Worldwide accepted a roughly $2.9 billion buyout offer from Brookfield.
The plumbing-supplies company has faced U.S. tariff pressure and weaker Americas sales.
Reuters said the deal offers a reprieve amid economic uncertainty.

articles.title: NHTSA orders Tesla to answer Cybercab certification questions
bullets: U.S. regulators gave Tesla until September 30 to respond to Cybercab compliance questions.
The probe focuses on whether Tesla properly self-certified its autonomous robotaxi.
Questions include whether temporary human controls were part of the compliance basis.

articles.title: AWS unable to restore Bahrain and UAE cloud access after Iran-war damage
bullets: Reuters reported AWS had not restored access to Bahrain infrastructure and one UAE cloud zone.
The disruption followed damage tied to the Iran war, according to an update seen by Reuters.
The outage highlights business-continuity risks for cloud regions in conflict zones.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology, AI, chips and platform updates

articles.title: AI rivals find rare agreement on slowing frontier development
bullets: AP reported leading AI figures are converging on calls to slow advanced AI development.
The discussion follows warnings from Anthropic and other industry leaders about catastrophic risks.
Experts said implementation remains difficult without enforceable standards.

articles.title: Microsoft commits to broad AI privacy rules for students
bullets: Microsoft announced sweeping AI privacy protections for student users.
The move comes as major school districts pause or reassess student AI use.
OpenAI called the step an important milestone for AI safety and privacy in schools.

articles.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking models
bullets: Google DeepMind published model details for Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking.
The models support real-time multimodal dialogue with audio, images, video and text.
Google says the models are designed for high-volume, low-latency voice-agent use cases.
articles.source: Google DeepMind / Google AI for Developers

articles.title: Apple releases iOS 27 and major platform updates
bullets: Apple said iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 and other updates are now available.
The release introduces Siri AI and new Apple Intelligence features.
Apple also highlighted new parental controls and cross-platform usability improvements.

articles.title: SK Hynix and Intel discuss U.S. memory-chip manufacturing deal
bullets: Reuters reported SK Hynix is in talks with Intel about making memory chips in the U.S.
A deal would mark SK Hynix’s first U.S. memory-chip manufacturing arrangement.
Sources said potential South Korean government concerns could be a hurdle.
